page_title: JUV 0-0 ROM | Juventus v AS Roma 01/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+5' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
90+3' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
90+3' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) sends the corner into the box, but Michele Di Gregorio intercepts it and averts the threat.
90+3' The ball is cleared after Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Corner kick. AS Roma will have an opportunity.
90+1' Angelino (AS Roma) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the right post.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the corner which is cleared.
90' A cross into the box from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is cleared. AS Roma have a corner.
88' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
85' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
85' Bremer (Juventus) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
85' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
85' The ball is cleared after Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Juventus.
84' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dusan Vlahovic leaves the pitch and Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) comes on.
82' Daniele De Rossi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) replacing Lorenzo Pellegrini.
82' It's time for a substitution. Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) comes on in place of Artem Dovbyk.
82' A cross by Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
81' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
79' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
79' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
77' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Dusan Vlahovic, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
76' The foul by Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) was seen by Marco Guida who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
73' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
72' A substitution has been made. Niccolo Pisilli is replaced by Manu Kone (AS Roma).
71' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
71' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Juventus get a corner.
70' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Weston McKennie (Juventus) is coming onto the pitch as Manuel Locatelli cannot continue after picking up an injury.
67' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Nicolo Fagioli is replaced by Douglas Luiz (Juventus).
65' Juventus are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
62' Daniele De Rossi decides to make a substitution. Alexis Saelemaekers will be replaced by Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma).
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) comes onto the pitch so that Matias Soule can be given a rest.
60' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
59' Looks like Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
58' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
56' AS Roma are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
53' Matias Soule (AS Roma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
52' A cross from Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
51' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marco Guida no option but to blow his whistle.
50' Angelino (AS Roma) commits a foul and Marco Guida immediately signals a free kick.
49' Marco Guida blows his whistle. Bremer (Juventus) commits a foul after dangerous play.
48' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
48' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is caught offside!
47' Matias Soule (AS Roma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
46' Half-time substitution. Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) will not participate anymore and Francisco Conceicao is coming on.
46' Thiago Motta makes a half-time substitution. Teun Koopmeiners comes on in place of Juan Cabal (Juventus).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Marco Guida has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Matias Soule (AS Roma) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
45+2' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
45+1' Juan Cabal (Juventus) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) for his blatant foul.
43' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

42' Mile Svilar pulls off a great save to deny Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! Juventus force their opponents to concede a corner.
40' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
39' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
38' Nicolo Savona (Juventus) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Juventus earn a corner.
36' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
34' Juventus keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
31' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
30' Matias Soule (AS Roma) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
26' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
25' AS Roma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
24' Marco Guida blows his whistle and it's Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
23' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Nicolo Savona (Juventus), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
22' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
22' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

21' Juventus are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
17' Matias Soule (AS Roma) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
16' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is penalised for a foul. Marco Guida had a clear view and blows his whistle.
14' AS Roma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

13' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
12' Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
11' Foul! Federico Gatti (Juventus) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
11' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
9' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is penalised for holding. Marco Guida signals a set piece. Juventus have a free kick from a promising distance.
8' The AS Roma players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
7' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
4' The ball is cleared after Matias Soule (AS Roma) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) was quite harsh and Marco Guida didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Juventus will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Marco Guida.
